The scale byte on a real machine

You will learn

What the native compiler checks in the same spec, including what the browser skipped.

The player in the last lesson could not run every check in e8m0.t27, and it said so. This recording runs the native t27c and Zig on a real machine on the same spec: its constants, the test report, the Zig tests, and the Verilog for the NaN check. Some checks are invariants the compiler proves while it compiles, so compiling is the check. Every byte in the recording was printed by the command; only the typing is staged.

Find how many invariants the test report proved at compile time, and compare its pass count with the player's.
